warmup: Can you walk me through your professional background briefly?
What attracted you to this role and organization?
How would your most recent manager describe your working style?
What has been the most interesting project you worked on recently?
Tell me about a typical day in your current or most recent role.
behavioral: Tell me about a time you handled a difficult situation at work.
Describe a time you had to work under significant pressure.
Give an example of when you had to adapt quickly to unexpected changes.
Tell me about a time you received critical feedback and how you responded.
Describe a conflict with a colleague and how you resolved it.
Tell me about a time you had to make a decision without complete information.
Give an example of a time you failed at something and what you learned.
Describe a situation where you had to persuade someone to see your point of view.
leadership: Describe a time you led a team through a challenging project.
Tell me about a time you had to mentor or develop a team member.
Give an example of when you had to make an unpopular decision as a leader.
Describe how you handled a situation where your team disagreed on an approach.
Tell me about a time you had to delegate a critical task and how you ensured success.
situational: What would you do if a project deadline suddenly moved forward by two weeks?
How would you handle a team member who is consistently underperforming?
If you discovered a critical bug in production right before a major release, what would you do?
How would you approach building a feature from scratch with ambiguous requirements?
What would you do if a stakeholder kept changing requirements mid-sprint?
How would you handle inheriting a large codebase with minimal documentation?
stress_test: Tell me about the biggest professional mistake you have made and its consequences.
Describe a time when everything went wrong on a project. What did you do?
Have you ever had to push back against a senior leader? What happened?
Tell me about a time you were given an impossible deadline.
Describe a situation where you had to deliver bad news to a client or stakeholder.
role_specific: Describe your experience with the primary technologies listed in this role.
How do you stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies?
Tell me about a time you introduced a new tool or process that improved team productivity.
What is your approach to code review and maintaining code quality?
Describe your experience working in agile or cross-functional teams.
